GET /nt/profiles/:user_id.description: Obtener perfil nutricional de un usuario
GET /nt/profiles/:user_id.returns: { id, user_id, gender, birth_date, weight_kg, height_cm, activity_level, diet_type, created_at, updated_at }

PUT /nt/profiles/:user_id.body: { gender?, birth_date?, weight_kg?, height_cm?, activity_level?, diet_type? }
PUT /nt/profiles/:user_id.returns: { id, user_id, gender, birth_date, weight_kg, height_cm, activity_level, diet_type }

GET /nt/meals.returns: [{ id, user_id, daily_record_id, meal_type, food_name, food_image_url, calories, proteins, carbs, fats, sugars, fiber, sodium, recorded_at }]

POST /nt/meals.body: { user_id, daily_record_id, meal_type, food_name, food_image_url?, calories, proteins, carbs, fats, sugars?, fiber?, sodium?, ingredients? }
POST /nt/meals.returns: { id, user_id, daily_record_id, meal_type, food_name, calories, proteins, carbs, fats }

GET /nt/meals/:id.returns: { id, user_id, meal_type, food_name, food_image_url, calories, proteins, carbs, fats, sugars, fiber, sodium, ingredients, recorded_at }

PUT /nt/meals/:id.body: { meal_type?, food_name?, calories?, proteins?, carbs?, fats?, sugars?, fiber?, sodium? }
PUT /nt/meals/:id.returns: { id, food_name, calories, proteins, carbs, fats }

GET /nt/daily-records.returns: { id, user_id, record_date, calorie_goal, protein_goal, carbs_goal, fat_goal, hydration_goal, total_calories, total_proteins, total_carbs, total_fats, total_hydration, meals: [...] }

POST /nt/daily-records.description: Crear registro diario (se crea automáticamente al primer acceso del día)
POST /nt/daily-records.body: { user_id, record_date, calorie_goal?, protein_goal?, carbs_goal?, fat_goal?, hydration_goal? }
POST /nt/daily-records.returns: { id, user_id, record_date, calorie_goal, protein_goal, carbs_goal, fat_goal, hydration_goal }

GET /nt/hydration.returns: { records: [{ id, amount_ml, recorded_at }], total_ml, goal_ml }

GET /nt/subscriptions.returns: { id, user_id, plan_type, start_date, end_date, status, days_remaining }

POST /nt/subscriptions.returns: { id, user_id, plan_type, status, start_date, end_date }

GET /nt/goals.returns: { id, user_id, diet_type, target_calories, target_proteins, target_carbs, target_fats }

PUT /nt/goals.returns: { id, user_id, diet_type, target_calories, target_proteins, target_carbs, target_fats }

GET /nt/dashboard.returns: { today: { calories, proteins, carbs, fats, hydration }, goals: { calories, proteins, carbs, fats, hydration }, meals_today: int, streak_days: int }
